title: 51 - Wedding
summary: At [[location:vulcan]], [[character:dr-sheehy|Bridget]] marries [[character:stephane-brodeur|Stéphane]]. [[character:howard]] attends from afar, wishes them well and leaves early, unhappy; [[character:bill]] talks him out of altering his [[technology:vr|VR]] so that he can get drunk. Because his legal standing is unsettled, [[character:ms-benning|Ms. Benning]], a lawyer in [[location:landing]], files his papers in two versions, giving the couple all of the [[organization:enniscorthy-distillery-company|distillery]] as a wedding gift. [[character:dexter]], the Bob who escorted Exodus-7 to Vulcan, accepts Howard's offer to stay on as resident Bob. With no target system chosen yet, and promising to stay reachable by [[technology:subspace-communications|SCUT]], Howard says goodbye: Stéphane asks why he is giving it all up, and a tearful Bridget tells him he is human where it matters.

introducing.name: Dexter
introducing.description: A Bob who escorted the colony ship Exodus-7 to [[location:vulcan]] and stayed on there as resident Bob at [[character:howard]]'s invitation.
introducing.current_state: At [[location:omicron2-eridani]], he takes over from [[character:howard]] as resident Bob for [[location:vulcan]], ready to step in after reading Howard's detailed blog. Visiting Howard in VR, he teases him about joining the Foreign Legion.

introducing.name: Ms. Benning
introducing.description: One of the two lawyers doing business in [[location:landing]] on [[location:vulcan]].
introducing.current_state: She completed and filed [[character:howard]]'s papers for his wedding gift to [[character:dr-sheehy|Bridget]] and [[character:stephane-brodeur|Stéphane]] in two versions, one assuming he has legal standing and one assuming he does not.

updates.current_state: After [[character:dr-sheehy|Bridget]] weds [[character:stephane-brodeur|Stéphane]], he gives them all of the [[organization:enniscorthy-distillery-company|distillery]] as a wedding gift, makes [[character:dexter]] resident Bob of Vulcan and says goodbye, leaving to explore with no target chosen yet.

Newly married to [[character:stephane-brodeur|Stéphane]], she is to own the [[organization:enniscorthy-distillery-company|distillery]] with him once they sign [[character:howard]]'s gift papers. Near tears at his leaving, she tells him he is human where it matters and wishes she had met him alive.

Newly married to [[character:dr-sheehy|Bridget]], he calls [[character:howard]]'s gift of the [[organization:enniscorthy-distillery-company|distillery]] generous but asks why Howard is giving it up, says he will miss him and leaves with the papers.

[[character:howard]] is giving it to [[character:dr-sheehy|Bridget]] and [[character:stephane-brodeur|Stéphane]] as a wedding gift; once they sign, the couple will own all of it. It is becoming one of the biggest companies on [[location:vulcan]].
